price.quote: Just weeks after releasing the updated 500W version of its incredibly popular XP Trike, Lectric’s top-tier 750W model is now for sale. The XP Trike2 750, which retails for $1,799, features a more powerful motor, a larger battery, and the widest selection of color options we’ve seen on a model from this company to date.

cls.quote: Five riding modes deliver the speed and power to own the road as a Class 1 or 2 eBike.* New simplified labels, including Eco, Tour, Sport, Sport+, & Turbo, allow riders to choose their riding experience. ⟶ Beginner Preset
